The '''Polomie system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Oriolan sector/Legends|Oriolan sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Polomie]].
